question: In March 2022, ________ has been elected as the superior general of the Missionaries of Charity, becoming the fourth occupant of the top post of the global organisation founded by Saint Teresa of Kolkata.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sister Mary Joseph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In March 2022, **Sister Mary Joseph** has been elected as the superior general of the Missionaries of Charity, becoming the fourth occupant of the top post of the global organization founded by Saint Teresa of Kolkata.

 
• **Succession of Leadership:** Sister Mary Joseph's election marked a transition in leadership for the Missionaries of Charity, following in the footsteps of Saint Teresa, the order's founder, and her successors.
 
• **Role of Superior General:** The Superior General is the leader of the Missionaries of Charity, responsible for overseeing the order's global operations and spiritual direction.
 
• **Global Organization:** The Missionaries of Charity is a global religious congregation, with sisters working in numerous countries around the world, serving the poorest of the poor.
 
• **Founded by Saint Teresa:** The order was founded by Mother Teresa (later Saint Teresa of Kolkata) in 1950 in Kolkata, India.
 
• **Charitable Work:** The Missionaries of Charity are renowned for their compassionate work with the destitute, the sick, and the marginalized.
 
• **Focus on the Poorest of the Poor:** Their mission is centered on serving the "poorest of the poor," providing them with care, dignity, and love.
 
• **Spread of the Mission:** The Missionaries of Charity's work has expanded significantly since its inception, with houses and missions established across the globe.
 
• **Sister Mary Joseph's Background:** Sister Mary Joseph's election as Superior General came after years of service within the Missionaries of Charity.
 
• **Experience and Dedication:** She brought a wealth of experience and a deep commitment to the order's charism to her new role.
 
• **Election Process:** The election of the Superior General is a process of discernment and prayer, involving members of the congregation.
 
• **Spiritual Guidance:** The Superior General provides spiritual guidance and leadership to the sisters of the Missionaries of Charity.
